Plan Name Gold PPO
Plan ID PLAN-001
Effective Date January 1, 2025
Plan Type Preferred Provider Organization (PPO)
Welcome to Your Gold PPO Plan
This booklet summarizes your health benefits under the Gold PPO plan. It explains covered services, your
financial responsibilities, and important exclusions and limitations.
Benefits summary accurate as of January 1, 2025.

Gold PPO Plan • PLAN-001 • Benefits Summary Page 3
2. Cost-Sharing Summary
Cost-Sharing Element In-Network Out-of-Network
Annual Deductible (Individual) $1,000 $2,000
Annual Deductible (Family) $2,000 $4,000
Out-of-Pocket Maximum (Individual) $6,000 $12,000
Out-of-Pocket Maximum (Family) $12,000 $24,000
Coinsurance (after deductible) 20% 40%
Primary Care Copay $25 Not covered
Specialist Copay $50 Not covered
Cost-sharing amounts may apply according to service category, network status, deductible, and applicable coinsurance.
3. Exclusions & Limitations
The following services are NOT covered under this plan, subject to the stated exceptions or limitations:
• Cosmetic surgery (unless medically necessary)
• Experimental or investigational treatments
• Infertility treatments (excluding diagnostic testing)
• Weight loss surgery (unless BMI ≥ 40 with comorbidities)
• Acupuncture and chiropractic care (limited to 20 visits/year)
• Routine eye exams and glasses (for members under 18 only)

• Benefits are subject to change with 60 days’ notice
• This document is a summary and does not replace the formal policy document
Reference This benefits summary is accurate as of January 1, 2025. For complete details, refer to
your Evidence of Coverage (EOC) document.
